title: Fallback cohort compatibility curation — tokenizer/context/tooling parity maintenance
creator: Asha Patel
description: Maintain a living compatibility catalog for fallback model cohorts focused on tokenizer parity, context window and tooling (KV/cache, batching, quant paths). Rather than a monolithic matrix sweep, this ticket defines a cohort-driven curation process, automated checks, and preflight gating so that when routing policies select a fallback variant we can guarantee behavioral and runtime interoperability. The goal is to reduce customer-facing regressions from fallback switches and to speed onboarding for new variant types.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort taxonomy defined and documented (tokenizer family, context bucket, kv-cache semantics, runtime tooling flags)
Automated compatibility check runs in CI for new model variant PRs (tokenizer parity smoke + sample generation comparison)
Nightly sanity job populates compat scores and flags regressions on the compat dashboard (no manual steps required)
Runbook exists for emergency rollback and manual validation for any flagged high-severity incompatibility
Routing can annotate fallback candidates with compat_score and compat_tags used by smart-router policies
progress_updates: 2026-02-10: Kickoff — aligned stakeholders (runtime, model-onboarding, routing) and scoped cohort taxonomy. Decided to prioritize tokenizer families that diverge (bytepair vs wordpiece vs unigram) and context extremes (<=2048, 2048-8192, >8192).

2026-02-18: Prototype tokenizer smoke test implemented — roundtrip tokenization and example generation diffing. Early discovery: 2 variants with same vocab but different normalization rules caused whitespace drift in completions (see PR #3911).

2026-02-28: Telemetry query drafted to surface fallback-triggered errors over last 90 days (routing.logs -> error.type = 'fallback-incompatibility'). Initial run showed 7 incidents; 4 traced to KV cache eviction semantics mismatch.

2026-03-05: Implemented compat_score model (heuristic weighted score: tokenizer_parity 40%, kv_semantics 30%, context_behavior 20%, tooling_flags 10%). Discussed moving to ML-based classifier in future iteration.
2026-03-12: CI preflight hook added to model-onboarding repo to run tokenizer smoke + sample generation. Two failing variants blocked merge; assigned remediation tickets to model-onboarding team.
test_plan: Unit: tokenizer roundtrip tests for all tokenizer families in cohort (CI, per-variant)
Integration: generate 50 sample prompts per cohort and compare decoded outputs for significant diffs (allow minor whitespace diffs unless normalization mismatch)
Runtime: simulate KV cache patterns (long prefix reuse / short burst) in staging to validate eviction parity and cached prefix results
Load: run a reduced-throughput routing smoke with fallback enabled to validate no latency regressions >10% for flagged variants
Manual: QA checklist for variants flagged with compat_score < 0.7 (human review of semantics and tooling behavior)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): Enable compat gating for 'experimental' routing tier only; block fallback selection for variants with compat_score < 0.6
Phase 2 (canary): Apply gating to 10% of traffic for tiered routing; monitor error rate and semantic divergence metrics for 72 hours
Phase 3 (gradual): Incrementally expand gating to 100% of traffic for tiered routing; enable automated alerts for any drop in generation-quality SLOs
Fallback handling: if a flagged incompatibility arrives in prod, router routes to next-highest compat_score variant and triggers oncall notification and rollback playbook
notes: Trade-offs: strict compat gating reduces fallback coverage in capacity-constrained outages; we accepted temporary reduced fallback breadth to avoid behavioral regressions for high-traffic customers.
Future: plan to add a small lightweight ML model to predict semantic drift between variants using embedding distance on canonical prompts rather than heuristics.
Ops: add a daily digest to #routing-ops Slack summarizing variants with compat_score drops and any blocked onboarding PRs
